title: UI Overhaul, Graph Visualizations, Viral Meter, Compare Reels, Conclusion Screen & More

requirements.summary: Update app-wide color scheme to dark purple → electric blue gradient background with neon pink/blue accents and white text
acceptanceCriteria: App background displays a dark purple → electric blue gradient
Primary accent color is neon pink and secondary is electric blue
All body text is white or near-white for high contrast
No warm-tone orange/magenta remnants remain as primary palette colors
All existing components visually integrate with the new palette

file_operations.description: Update CSS custom properties to replace existing color palette with dark purple → electric blue gradient values. Replace --background with a gradient definition (dark purple to electric blue). Update --primary to neon pink (#FF10F0), --secondary to electric blue (#00D9FF), and ensure --foreground is white or near-white. Remove any warm-tone color definitions.

Update theme.extend.colors to map purple, hotPink, and cyan to the new neon pink (#FF10F0) and electric blue (#00D9FF) palette. Ensure background gradient utilities support dark purple to electric blue transitions.

Apply the dark purple → electric blue gradient background to the main container div using Tailwind gradient utilities (e.g., bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-900 via-purple-800 to-blue-600). Ensure the gradient covers the entire app shell and all child components inherit or complement the palette.

requirements.summary: Add emoji icons (👁 Views, ❤️ Likes, 💬 Comments, 🔁 Shares) as input prefix adornments in Engagement Calculator
acceptanceCriteria: Each of the four inputs in the Engagement Calculator displays its corresponding emoji icon as a left-side prefix
Icons are visible and do not obscure the typed value
Input styling remains consistent with the existing neon border/glassmorphism design

file_operations.description: Wrap each input element (Views, Likes, Comments, Shares) in a relative container div. Add an absolute-positioned emoji span as a left prefix inside each input: 👁 for Views, ❤️ for Likes, 💬 for Comments, 🔁 for Shares. Apply left padding to the input to prevent text overlap with the emoji. Maintain existing glassmorphism and neon border styles.

requirements.summary: Upgrade all section and tool headings to larger sizes (text-3xl/text-4xl), bold weight, and gradient text styling
acceptanceCriteria: Primary tool/section headings are visually larger than before (text-3xl or greater)
Headings use bold font weight
Headings render with gradient text color using the app's neon palette

file_operations.description: Update the main app title 'Viral Math' and subtitle 'Understand Virality Through Mathematics' to use text-4xl or text-5xl, font-bold, and the gradient-text utility class. Ensure the gradient uses the new neon pink → electric blue palette.
Update the heading 'Engagement Rate Calculator' to text-3xl, font-bold, and apply gradient-text utility class.
Update the heading 'Viral Growth Simulator' to text-3xl, font-bold, and apply gradient-text utility class.
Update the heading 'View Decay Simulator' to text-3xl, font-bold, and apply gradient-text utility class.

requirements.summary: Add smooth scale-in and fade-in entrance animations (300–500ms) to result displays in all calculators
acceptanceCriteria: Result cards in all three calculators animate in with a scale + fade effect on first render
Animation plays each time a new result is calculated
Animation does not block or delay result display beyond the animation duration itself

file_operations.description: Add Tailwind animate-in or transition classes to the root div: apply transition-all duration-500 ease-out, and use a conditional class that applies opacity-0 scale-95 initially, then opacity-100 scale-100 when the component mounts. Alternatively, use a CSS keyframe animation for scale + fade-in over 400ms.
Ensure the result rendering logic triggers the ResultCard animation by toggling a key or state flag each time a new result is calculated, so the animation replays on every Calculate click.
Ensure the result rendering logic triggers the ResultCard animation by toggling a key or state flag each time a new result is calculated, so the animation replays on every Simulate click.
Ensure the result rendering logic triggers the ResultCard animation by toggling a key or state flag each time a new result is calculated, so the animation replays on every Simulate click.

requirements.summary: Add 1-second loading spinner animation to all Calculate/Simulate buttons before showing results
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Calculate/Simulate shows a spinner inside the button for ~1 second
The button is disabled during the loading state to prevent double-submission
After ~1 second the spinner disappears and the result is displayed with the entrance animation

file_operations.description: Add a loading state (useState). On Calculate button click, set loading to true, disable the button, and show a spinning icon (e.g., an SVG spinner or a rotating circle using animate-spin) inside the button text. After 1000ms (setTimeout), set loading to false and compute/display the result.

Add a loading state (useState). On Simulate button click, set loading to true, disable the button, and show a spinning icon inside the button text. After 1000ms (setTimeout), set loading to false and compute/display the result.

Add a loading state (useState). On Simulate button click, set loading to true, disable the button, and show a spinning icon inside the button text. After 1000ms (setTimeout), set loading to false and compute/display the result.

requirements.summary: Add glowing pulse hover effect and scale-down bounce click animation to all action buttons
acceptanceCriteria: All Calculate/Simulate buttons display a neon glow shadow on hover
Clicking a button triggers a brief scale bounce animation
The glowing effect uses the app's neon pink or electric blue palette

file_operations.description: Add hover:glow-pink (or similar existing glow utility) and active:scale-95 transition-transform classes to the Calculate button. Ensure the glow shadow uses neon pink from the updated palette.
Add hover:glow-cyan (or similar existing glow utility) and active:scale-95 transition-transform classes to the Simulate button. Ensure the glow shadow uses electric blue from the updated palette.

Add hover:glow-pink (or similar existing glow utility) and active:scale-95 transition-transform classes to the Simulate button. Ensure the glow shadow uses neon pink or electric blue from the updated palette.

requirements.summary: Add interactive bar chart below Engagement Calculator result showing Likes, Comments, Shares breakdown
acceptanceCriteria: A bar chart appears below the Engagement Calculator result showing Likes, Comments, and Shares bars
Bars are labeled with their numeric values
Chart uses neon colors consistent with the app palette
Chart only renders when a valid engagement result is present

file_operations.description: Create a new functional component EngagementBarChart that accepts props: likes, comments, shares (all numbers). Render three horizontal or vertical bars using SVG or CSS (flex with height/width based on value ratios). Style each bar with a neon color (pink, cyan, purple) and display the numeric value as a label inside or above each bar. Wrap in a glassmorphism card container.
Import and render the EngagementBarChart component below the ResultCard when a valid result exists. Pass the likes, comments, and shares input values as props to the chart component.

requirements.summary: Add interactive exponential growth curve chart below Growth Simulator result
acceptanceCriteria: An exponential growth curve appears below the Growth Simulator result
X-axis shows rounds 0 through N (user input), Y-axis shows total reach at each round
Curve is rendered in a neon accent color with the glassmorphism card background
Chart only renders when a valid simulation result is present

file_operations.description: Create a new functional component GrowthCurveChart that accepts props: initialViewers (number), sharesPerPerson (number), rounds (number). Compute total reach at each round from 0 to rounds using the formula: initialViewers * (sharesPerPerson ^ round). Render an SVG line chart with X-axis (rounds) and Y-axis (reach). Style the curve line with a neon electric blue stroke and wrap in a glassmorphism card.
Import and render the GrowthCurveChart component below the ResultCard when a valid result exists. Pass the initialViewers, sharesPerPerson, and rounds input values as props to the chart component.

requirements.summary: Add interactive decay curve chart below Decay Simulator result
acceptanceCriteria: A decay curve appears below the Decay Simulator result
X-axis shows days 0 through N (user input), Y-axis shows remaining views at each day
Curve descends from peak views toward zero styled in neon accent color
Chart only renders when a valid simulation result is present

file_operations.description: Create a new functional component DecayCurveChart that accepts props: peakViews (number), decayRate (number), days (number). Compute remaining views at each day from 0 to days using the formula: peakViews * ((1 - decayRate/100) ^ day). Render an SVG line chart with X-axis (days) and Y-axis (views). Style the curve line with a neon pink or purple stroke and wrap in a glassmorphism card.
Import and render the DecayCurveChart component below the ResultCard when a valid result exists. Pass the peakViews, decayRate, and days input values as props to the chart component.

requirements.summary: Add Viral Prediction Meter (speedometer gauge with red/yellow/green zones) to Engagement Calculator results
acceptanceCriteria: A speedometer/gauge element appears in the Engagement Calculator after a valid result
Gauge displays three colored zones: red (0–3%), yellow (3–7%), green (7%+)
A visual indicator (needle or arc fill) shows the computed engagement rate position
The current zone label (Low / Medium / High Viral Chance) is displayed as text
Gauge only renders when a valid engagement result is present

file_operations.description: Create a new functional component ViralMeter that accepts props: engagementRate (number, 0–100). Render an SVG-based speedometer gauge with three arc segments: red (0–3%), yellow (3–7%), green (7%+). Position a needle or fill an arc segment to indicate the engagementRate value. Display a label below the gauge showing the zone: '🔴 Low' (0–3%), '🟡 Medium' (3–7%), or '🟢 High Viral Chance' (7%+). Wrap in a glassmorphism card.
Import and render the ViralMeter component below the ResultCard when a valid result exists. Pass the computed engagementRate as a prop to the ViralMeter component.

requirements.summary: Create 'Compare Two Reels' screen with side-by-side input panels and winner declaration
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Compare Two Reels' tab/screen is accessible from the main navigation
Two input panels accept Views, Likes, Comments, and Shares for Reel 1 and Reel 2
A 'Compare' button triggers computation of engagement rate for both reels
Results display each reel's engagement rate and a winner banner highlighting the higher one
Tie case is handled gracefully (e.g., 'It's a Tie! 🤝')
Validation shows an error message if any field is empty or invalid
UI uses glassmorphism card style, neon gradients, and Space Grotesk font

file_operations.description: Create a new functional component CompareReels. Render two input panels side-by-side (or stacked on mobile) with four inputs each (Views, Likes, Comments, Shares) for Reel 1 and Reel 2. Add a 'Compare' button that validates all inputs and computes the engagement rate for each reel using the formula (Likes + Comments + Shares) / Views * 100. Display each reel's engagement rate in ResultCard components and show a winner banner ('🏆 Reel 1 Wins!' or '🏆 Reel 2 Wins!' or 'It's a Tie! 🤝') based on which rate is higher. Show an error message if any field is empty or invalid. Style with glassmorphism cards, neon gradients, and Space Grotesk font.

Add a new tab 'Compare Two Reels' to the navigation tabs array (likely in the Calculators section). Update the conditional rendering logic to display the CompareReels component when this tab is active. Ensure the tab button styling matches existing tabs with glassmorphism and neon accent colors.

requirements.summary: Create 'Why Reels Go Viral?' informational screen explaining key virality factors
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Why Reels Go Viral?' screen or section is accessible from the navigation
At least three factors are displayed: watch time, shares, hook in first 3 seconds
Each factor has an emoji/icon, bold title, and short explanation
UI is styled with glassmorphism cards and neon accents

file_operations.description: Create a new functional component WhyReelsGoViral. Render three glassmorphism cards, each containing: (1) '⏱️ High Watch Time' with explanation 'Keeping viewers engaged longer signals quality to the algorithm, boosting promotion.', (2) '🔁 More Shares' with explanation 'Each share amplifies reach exponentially, spreading your content to new audiences.', (3) '🎯 Strong Hook in First 3 Seconds' with explanation 'Capturing attention immediately prevents users from scrolling past your reel.' Style each card with an emoji, bold text-xl title, and a one-to-two sentence explanation. Apply glassmorphism, neon gradients, and Space Grotesk font.

Add a new tab 'Why Reels Go Viral?' to the navigation tabs array (likely in the Learn section). Update the conditional rendering logic to display the WhyReelsGoViral component when this tab is active. Ensure the tab button styling matches existing tabs.
